=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #4545's suggested fix asks to "give each source-repo model attempt a disposable copy of the index via an invocation-scoped `GIT_INDEX_FILE`" so that "a model-issued `git add` ... writes to the scratch copy instead of the real index."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` — the per-attempt loop body; `tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_prelude_render.py` — the wiring test.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The wiring test fails at CI (run 37097774118) because the merge from `main` brought in #5627's `env "GIT_INDEX_FILE=${RESOLVER_MODEL_INDEX_FILE}"` prefix on `resolver_opencode_cmd` at line 2394, which shadows #4545's `export GIT_INDEX_FILE="${RESOLVER_SCRATCH_INDEX}"` at line 2418 for the model process. The scratch index is dead code — the model never reads it. The two mechanisms need to be reconciled: either remove #4545's redundant scratch index mechanism (since #5627 already provides the same isolation via `env` prefix), or update the test to account for #5627's mechanism being canonical. Three tests fail as a result: `test_scope_index_isolation_wiring_scoped_to_model_attempt` (line 777), `test_private_model_index_wiring` (line 1300), and `test_resolver_opencode_snapshot_opt_out` (line 1275).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
